mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates for equity valuation, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of HOUST < 600 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) over the prior 6 months signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising GDPC1 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals weakening supply chain activity that reduces corporate output and earnings expectations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below -0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of INDPRO < 105.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer and housing demand that boosts corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising RSAFS and rising HOUST are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 620 thousand units signals reduced consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of HOUST < 620 during high inflation are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
